prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one wide panoramic photographic background asset for a website call-to-action for Surtario, a restaurant ingredient sourcing prototype. No text or UI in the image. Aspect ratio 3:1, ideally 1800 by 600 pixels. Art-directed overhead/oblique view of a restaurant's ingredient receiving and planning table: a modest wooden produce crate with fresh limes, radishes and leafy greens, the edge of an open paper sack of uncooked grains, a plain folded linen, a partially visible blank paper order sheet and pencil. Compose as a continuous immersive scene, NOT isolated objects on blank background, NOT a collage, NOT a bowl of rice, no cooked meals. Objects form an organic diagonal arrangement across center and right with a few softly out-of-focus foreground leaves at the edges. Left half is a real dark aubergine work surface in soft focus with subtle shadows and traces of the scene, calm enough for white HTML heading and body overlaid later, but not a solid empty color slab. Main ingredients on right remain recognizable, with gentle photographic depth of field and artistic lens diffusion. Restrained Surtario palette: deep burgundy/aubergine #42202D in shadows, dusty rose accents, natural lime green and porcelain highlights. Low-key soft directional daylight, tactile and editorial, inviting and refined. Fill the entire image edge to edge. No lettering, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no borders, no interface, no recognizable people. This is atmosphere for exploring supplier options and planning ingredients, not an image of one product for sale.
